metadata.notes: record_date is publication date; observation_date/end_of_month is the holding date. Raw source zeros preserved. Treasury documents zeros before March 2024 as unavailable; usable value is blank for those rows. API history begins in 2021 and is not a complete 20-year monthly history. Do not combine multiple publications of the same observation without choosing the latest.
